newsitem.title: USA: Tyson to sell Gorges/Quick-To-Fix Plants.
newsitem.headline: Tyson to sell Gorges/Quick-To-Fix Plants.

text.p: Tyson Foods Inc said Monday it agreed to sell its Gorges/Quick-To-Fix beef processing plants to a company formed by the existing senior management members of the Gorges/Quick-To-Fix unit and their financial partner, Cravey, Green & Wahlen Inc.

The decision to sell the balance of the red meat division was first announced in April. This is the second step in a planned move away from red meat processing that began last year when Tyson sold its pork processing plant in Marshall, Missouri to Cargill Inc.
Tyson said it does not expect significant changes in the day-to-day operations of the four plants, which are located in Iowa and Texas.
The deal is expected to be completed by the end of November, subject to regulatory approvals and financing.
